## Haunting Image Resurfaces, Reminds the World of Lampedusa Tragedy

A powerful and somber image from 2013 has been circulating online, serving as a stark reminder of the human cost of migration across the Mediterranean Sea. The photograph depicts a row of coffins in Lampedusa, Italy, holding the remains of African migrants who perished in a shipwreck.

The incident, which occurred near the Italian island of Lampedusa in October 2013, resulted in the deaths of hundreds of people seeking refuge and a better life in Europe. Lampedusa, geographically located closer to North Africa than mainland Italy, has long been a primary arrival point for migrants and asylum seekers attempting to cross the Mediterranean from countries like Libya, Tunisia, and Eritrea.

The 2013 shipwreck was a particularly devastating event, triggering widespread outrage and calls for action to address the ongoing humanitarian crisis in the region. Boats carrying hundreds of people, often overcrowded and poorly maintained, regularly attempt the perilous journey, making them vulnerable to capsizing and other maritime disasters.

The image, though disturbing, highlights the desperation that compels individuals to risk their lives in search of safety and opportunity. Factors such as political instability, economic hardship, and persecution in their home countries often fuel the migration flows across the Mediterranean.

While the photograph is almost a decade old, the issues it represents remain tragically relevant today. Migration patterns continue to fluctuate, and the Mediterranean Sea remains a dangerous crossing for many. The need for coordinated search and rescue operations, safe and legal pathways for migration, and long-term solutions to address the root causes of displacement remains as urgent as ever. The image of those coffins in Lampedusa serves as a potent reminder of the human lives lost and the ongoing challenges faced by migrants and the nations grappling with their arrival.

## Pozorni slika povrati se, podseti svet na Lampedusovu tragediju

Sila i tuga slika iz 2013. godine kruži online, podseti svet na ljudsku cenu migracije preko sredozemnog mora. Fotografija prikazuje red košulja u Lampedusi, Italija, koja drži ostatak afričkih migranata koji su poginuli u brodskom incidentu.

Nastupio je incident blizu italijanskog otoka Lampedusa u oktobru 2013. godine, rezultirao je smrtnim slučajevima stotina ljudi koji su tražili azil i bolji život u Europi. Lampedusa, geografski blizu sjeverne Afrike nego kontinentalne Italije, je dugo bio glavna tačka dolaska za migrante i tražitelje azila koji pokušavaju preći sredozemno more iz zemalja kao što su Libija, Tunisa i Eritreja.

2013. godine brodski incident bio je posebno devastirajući događaj, uzrokovao je široku nemir i zahtev za akcijom da se reši održavajuća humanitarna kriza u regiji. Brodovi koji nose stotine ljudi, često prepunim i loš održanim, redovno pokušavaju opasnu putovanje, čime su oslobađeni od rizika od potapanja i drugih moreških katastrofa.

Slika, iako očajna, naglašava očajanje koje podstiče ljude da rizikuju život u potrazi za sigurnošću i prilikama. Faktori kao što su politička nestabilnost, ekonomski problemi i persekucija u zemljama gde su rođeni često podstiču migracije preko sredozemnog mora.

Iako je fotografija skoro deset godina stara, pitanja koja predstavlja ostaju tragoično relevantna danas. Migracioni tokovi nastavljaju da se variraju, a sredozemno more ostaje opasno prelaz za mnoge. Potreba za koordiniranim operacijama pretrage i spašavanja, sigurnim i legalnim putevima za migraciju, kao i dugoročnim rešenjima za rešavanje korena izbora ostaje koliko i uvek. Slika košulja u Lampedusi podstiče potencijalnu podsjetnicu na živote izgubljene i nastavak izazivača koje migranti i zemlje koje suočavaju njihov dolazak.

El suceso, que dejó cientos de muertos, destaca la vulnerabilidad de los migrantes que cruzan el Mediterráneo en embarcaciones precarias. Aunque el imagen data de una década, los desafíos migratorios persisten, reforzando la necesidad de soluciones humanitarias y políticas para abordar las causas raíz de la migración.

## Brazilian Beverage Company Pivots to Produce Hand Sanitizer for Brazilian Hospitals

Responding to the growing need for essential supplies during the current health crisis, a Brazilian beverage production company has announced it will dedicate part of its production capacity to manufacturing hand sanitizer. The company plans to donate 500,000 units of the essential product to municipal hospitals across three key regions: Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, and the Distrito Federal.

This initiative reflects a growing trend of private sector companies adapting their operations to address the critical shortages of medical supplies and hygiene products facing healthcare systems worldwide. With the surge in demand for hand sanitizer, hospitals, particularly municipal facilities serving large and often under-resourced populations, have struggled to maintain adequate stock.

The company’s decision to focus its donation on these specific regions demonstrates a strategic approach to maximizing impact. Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo, being two of the largest and most densely populated cities in Brazil, are particularly vulnerable to the spread of the virus. The Distrito Federal, housing the nation's capital, Brasília, also requires significant support to protect its healthcare infrastructure and the communities it serves.

By providing 500,000 units of hand sanitizer, the beverage company aims to directly contribute to infection control efforts within these municipal hospitals. The donated sanitizer will help healthcare workers, patients, and visitors maintain proper hand hygiene, a critical measure in preventing the spread of infectious diseases. This contribution is expected to alleviate some of the pressure on already strained hospital budgets and resources, allowing them to focus on providing essential medical care during this challenging time. The company’s action sets a positive example of corporate social responsibility in a time of national need.

## Ambev Denies Widespread Alcohol Gel Distribution, Warns of Phishing Scam

Ambev, the Brazilian brewing company and one of the largest beverage companies in the world, has issued a statement clarifying that it is *not* conducting a general distribution of alcohol-based hand sanitizer to the public. The clarification comes after a link circulating via WhatsApp led users to a fraudulent website impersonating the company.

According to Ambev’s press office, the link is part of a phishing scam designed to harvest personal information from unsuspecting individuals. The fake website mimics the appearance of a legitimate Ambev page, enticing users with the promise of free hand sanitizer. By clicking on the link and potentially providing personal details, users risk exposing themselves to identity theft and other forms of online fraud.

This incident highlights the increased prevalence of online scams exploiting the ongoing concerns about hygiene and public health. During periods of heightened health awareness, like the current global concern surrounding infectious diseases, malicious actors often capitalize on public anxiety to deploy scams promising much-needed supplies or information. These scams can take various forms, including fake surveys, promotional offers, or in this case, the false promise of free hygiene products.

Ambev is urging the public to exercise caution and avoid clicking on suspicious links, especially those received through messaging apps like WhatsApp. Users are advised to verify the authenticity of any offer or promotion directly through Ambev’s official website or social media channels before providing any personal information. The company is likely taking steps to address the fraudulent website and prevent further dissemination of the scam link. This incident serves as a crucial reminder to be vigilant and skeptical of unsolicited offers online, particularly those appearing too good to be true.

## شركة أمبيف تنفي توزيع واسع لمرهم الكحول وتحذر من خدعة التصيد

أصدرت شركة أمبيف، وهي شركة برازيلية لصناعة المشروبات ومصنعة المشروبات من بين أكبر الشركات في العالم، بيانًا يوضح أن الشركة لا تقوم بتوزيع عام لمرهم الكحول المطهر للجمهور. جاء هذا التوضيح بعد أن انتشر رابط عبر تطبيق واتساب أدى مستخدمي التطبيق إلى موقع إلكتروني مزيف يحاكي شركة أمبيف.

وبحسب مكتب إعلام شركة أمبيف، فإن هذا الرابط جزء من خدعة التصيد التي تهدف إلى جمع معلومات شخصية من الأشخاص غير المدركين. يشبه الموقع المزيف مظهر صفحة رسمية لشركة أمبيف ويغرّي المستخدمين بوعود مجانية بمرهم الكحول. من خلال النقر على الرابط وتقديم التفاصيل الشخصية، يعرض المستخدمون أنفسهم لخطر الاحتيال ومضاعفاته الأخرى.

تشير هذه الحادثة إلى انتشار زيادة في الاحتيال الإلكتروني الذي يستغل القلق الحالي حول النظافة والصحة العامة. خلال فترات الوعي الصحي المكثف، مثل القلق العالمي الحالي حول الأمراض العدوانية، يُستغل غالبًا القلق العام من قبل المجرمين لتنفيذ مخططات تقدم وعودًا بالمواد أو المعلومات التي يحتاجها الجمهور. ويمكن أن تتخذ هذه الاحتيال أشكالًا مختلفة، بما في ذلك استطلاعات رأي مزيفة أو عروض تسويقية، وفي هذه الحالة، الوعود الكاذبة بمنتجات النظافة المجانية.

تدعو أمبيف الجمهور إلى الحذر وتجنب النقر على الروابط المشبوهة، خاصة تلك التي تصل عبر تطبيقات الرسائل مثل واتساب. يُنصح المستخدمين بالتحقق من صحة أي عرض أو عرض ترويجي مباشرة عبر الموقع الرسمي لشركة أمبيف أو قنوات التواصل الاجتماعي الخاصة بها قبل تقديم أي معلومات شخصية. من المرجح أن تقوم الشركة باتخاذ خطوات لمعالجة الموقع المزيف ووقف انتشار رابط الاحتيال. هذه الحادثة تشكل تذكيرًا مهمًا بالتحلي بالحذر والشكك في العروض غير المرغوب فيها عبر الإنترنت، خاصة تلك التي يبدو أنها جذابة جدًا ليكون حقيقيًا.

## Petrobras Denies Refinery Shutdown Rumors Circulating Online

Rio de Janeiro – In response to a rapidly spreading online rumor, Petrobras' press office has officially refuted claims of a planned temporary shutdown of its refineries on the 24th of the month. The company issued a statement clarifying that the document circulating online, alleging the temporary closure, was not officially released by Petrobras.

The denial comes amidst growing concern and speculation fueled by the purported document's circulation across various social media platforms. The specifics of the document, which haven’t been disclosed by Petrobras, reportedly detailed plans for a temporary cessation of operations at several of the state-owned oil giant's refining facilities. This caused anxieties surrounding potential fuel shortages and subsequent price increases.

The statement released by the Petrobras press office aims to quell these anxieties. By emphasizing that the document was not officially published by the company, Petrobras is asserting that the information contained within is inaccurate and unreliable. Furthermore, the company explicitly stated that no temporary refinery closures are currently planned for the specified date.

The dissemination of unverified information, particularly regarding critical infrastructure like oil refineries, can have significant consequences on public perception and the national economy. In Brazil, Petrobras holds a dominant position in the refining sector, and any perceived disruption to its operations can trigger widespread concerns about fuel availability and pricing stability.

While the origin of the circulating document remains unknown, Petrobras’ swift response highlights the importance of verifying information before sharing it, especially in an era of widespread online misinformation. The company's proactive stance is aimed at maintaining stability and reassuring the public regarding the continued operation of its refining facilities. The incident also underscores the challenges faced by large corporations in managing their public image and combating the spread of unsubstantiated rumors on social media.

## بيتروبراس تنفي شائعات إغلاق مصانعها النفطية المتداولة على الإنترنت

ريو دي جانيريو – ردًا على انتشار واسع لشائعات على الإنترنت، نفت مكتب إعلام بيتروبراس بشكل رسمي ادعاءات تتحدث عن إغلاق مؤقت للمصانع النفطية في 24 من الشهر. ونشرت الشركة بيانًا يوضح أن الوثيقة المتداولة على الإنترنت التي تشير إلى إغلاق مؤقت لم تُصدر رسميًا من بيتروبراس.

وتأتي هذه النفي في ظل ازدياد المخاوف والتكهنات التي دفعتها انتشار هذه الوثيقة عبر منصات التواصل الاجتماعي المختلفة. وبحسب ما تم تقريره، تضمنت تفاصيل الوثيقة، التي لم تكشفها بيتروبراس، خططًا لإيقاف مؤقت للعمل في عدد من مصانع النفط المملوكة للدولة. مما أثار مخاوف متعلقة بانخفاض توافر الوقود وزيادة الأسعار.

ويهدف بيان مكتب إعلام بيتروبراس إلى تهدئة هذه المخاوف. من خلال التأكيد على أن الوثيقة لم تُنشر رسميًا من قبل الشركة، فإن بيتروبراس تؤكد أن المعلومات الموجودة فيها غير دقيقة وغير موثوقة. كما أوضحت الشركة صراحة أن لا توجد خطط لإغلاق مؤقت للمصانع النفطية في التاريخ المحدد.

ويمكن أن يكون انتشار المعلومات غير المثبتة، خاصة المتعلقة بالبنية التحتية الحيوية مثل المصانع النفطية، له عواقب كبيرة على الرأي العام والاقتصاد الوطني. في البرازيل، تهيمن بيتروبراس على قطاع التكرير، وعندما تظهر أي تشويش على عملياتها، تثير مخاوف واسعة حول توفر الوقود وثبات الأسعار.

بينما لا تزال مصادر الوثيقة المتداولة غير معروفة، فإن رد فعل بيتروبراس السريع يبرز أهمية التحقق من صحة المعلومات قبل نشرها، خاصة في العصر الذي يشهد انتشارًا واسعًا للأخبار الزائفة على الإنترنت. وتشمل المبادرة النشطة من الشركة الحفاظ على الاستقرار وطمأنة الجمهور على استمرار تشغيل مصانع التكرير التابعة لها. كما تسلط هذه الحادثة الضوء على التحديات التي تواجه الشركات الكبيرة في إدارة صورتها العامة والحد من انتشار الشائعات غير المدعومة على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي.

## Claim Lacking Scientific Basis Flagged on Social Media

A social media post making an unspecified claim has been flagged with a warning noting the absence of supporting scientific evidence. The notice, which appears to be an automated feature implemented by the social media platform, alerts users that, at the time of verification, no credible scientific studies or research existed to validate the assertion being made in the post.

This kind of fact-checking initiative has become increasingly common across social media platforms as they grapple with the spread of misinformation and disinformation. These efforts aim to provide users with context and help them differentiate between unsubstantiated claims and information backed by verifiable evidence.

The absence of scientific evidence does not automatically equate to the claim being false. However, it suggests a lack of rigorous investigation and peer-reviewed findings to support its validity. This is particularly crucial when the claim pertains to areas like health, science, or policy, where decisions and beliefs should ideally be informed by evidence-based information.

The specific claim in the flagged post remains undisclosed, but the warning itself serves as a reminder to consumers of online content to exercise critical thinking. Users are encouraged to seek information from reputable sources, cross-reference claims with established scientific understanding, and be wary of information that lacks supporting data or relies solely on anecdotal evidence.

The increasing prevalence of such warnings highlights the ongoing challenge of navigating the digital landscape and distinguishing between reliable and unreliable information. Social media platforms continue to refine their fact-checking processes and explore different methods for combating the spread of unverified claims. Users, in turn, need to be proactive in evaluating the information they encounter and seeking out credible sources to inform their understanding.

## Zahtjev bez znanstvene osnove označen na društvenim mrežama

Društvena mreža je označila objavu koja izlaže neodređen zahtjev, s upozorenjem o nedostatku znanstvenih dokaza koji bi podupirali tvrdnju. Upozorenje, koje izgleda kao automatizirana funkcija implementirana od strane društvene mreže, obavještava korisnike da, na trenutku provjere, nema pouzdanih znanstvenih istraživanja ili istraživanja koja bi potvrdila tvrdnju iz objave.

Ove vrste inicijativa za provjere činjenica postaju sve češće na društvenim mrežama, jer se platforme suočavaju s širenjem lažnih informacija i dezinformacija. Ove napade imaju cilj da korisnicima pruže kontekst i pomaže im da razlikuju između tvrdnji koje nisu potvrđene i informacija koja se oslanja na potvrđene dokaze.

Nedostatak znanstvenih dokaza ne znači automatski da je tvrdnja lažna. Međutim, to ukazuje na nedostatak pažljive istraživanja i znanstvenih nalaza koji bi podupirali njezinu važećnost. Ovo je posebno važno kada se tvrdnja odnosi na područja poput zdravlja, znanosti ili politike, gdje se odluke i stavovi trebali bi oslanjati na informacije koje su osnovane na dokazima.

Specifična tvrdnja koja je označena u objavi ostaje neobjavljena, ali upozorenje sam po sebi služi kao podsjetnik potrošačima online sadržaja da koriste kritičko razmišljanje. Korisnicima se preporučuje tražiti informacije iz pouzdanih izvora, pretraživati tvrdnje s postojećim znanstvenim razumijevanjem i biti oprezni prema informacijama koje nedostaju podupirajući podaci ili se oslanjaju isključivo na anekdotične dokaze.

Rastuća prisutnost ovakvih upozorenja ističe trajne izazove u navigaciji kroz digitalni prostor i razlikovanje pouzdanog i nepouzdanog informacija. Društvene mreže nastavljaju da poboljšavaju svoje procese provjere činjenica i istražuju različite metode za borbu protiv širenja neverificiranih tvrdnji. Uz to, korisnici trebaju biti aktivni u ocjenjivanju informacija koje susreću i tražiti pouzdana izvora za formiranje svoje razumijevanja.

## Hoax Alert: Viral Image of "Blessed" Hand Sanitizer Being Sold at Universal Church is Fake

A digitally manipulated image purporting to show hand sanitizer being sold as "blessed" by bishops within the Universal Church of the Kingdom of God (IURD) is circulating online, prompting the church to issue a statement dismissing the claims. The image, which has been shared widely across various social media platforms, appears to depict a bottle of hand sanitizer branded with IURD imagery and a claim that it has been blessed by church leaders.

However, the IURD has firmly denied the authenticity of the image and any involvement in the sale or endorsement of such a product. The statement released by the church emphasizes that the photograph is a fabrication and that the IURD does not engage in the practice of selling hand sanitizer, blessed or otherwise, at its temples.

The spread of this hoax highlights the ease with which misinformation can proliferate online, particularly during times of heightened anxiety and concern about public health. The COVID-19 pandemic has fueled a surge in demand for hand sanitizer, creating a vulnerable market susceptible to exploitation by fraudulent actors.

The motive behind the creation and dissemination of the fake image remains unclear. It could be intended as a satirical commentary on religious practices, or a more malicious attempt to discredit the IURD and spread false information. Whatever the intention, the incident serves as a reminder for social media users to exercise caution and critical thinking when encountering sensational or unbelievable content online. Fact-checking before sharing information is crucial to preventing the spread of misinformation and its potential consequences. Relying on reputable news sources and official statements from organizations like the IURD is essential in discerning truth from falsehood in the digital age.

The Ministry of Health has released a statement emphasizing the continued importance of using 70% alcohol-based hand sanitizer or liquid alcohol as a key preventative measure against the spread of the coronavirus. ## Misinformation Surrounding Provisional Measure 922/2020 Circulates Online

A recent wave of online discussion has centered around Provisional Measure (MP) nº 922/2020, sparking confusion and misinformation. A widespread claim circulating on social media incorrectly states that the federal government implemented the measure on March 18th and links it to measures taken in response to the Covid-19 pandemic. However, this information is demonstrably false.

In reality, Provisional Measure nº 922/2020 was established on February 28th, 2020, weeks before the severity of the Covid-19 pandemic became widely apparent and before significant preventative measures were implemented in Brazil. Provisional Measures, under Brazilian law, are temporary legal acts issued by the President that have the force of law immediately, but require subsequent approval by the National Congress within a specified period to become permanent legislation.

The significance of the incorrect date and implied connection to Covid-19 lies in the potential for misinterpretation and the fueling of distrust in government actions. Attributing the measure to the pandemic could falsely suggest it was enacted specifically to address the health crisis, potentially leading individuals to misinterpret its intended purpose and impact.

While the social media post correctly points out the date discrepancy and lack of connection to the pandemic, the spread of this misinformation highlights the importance of verifying information before sharing it online. Fact-checking and consulting reliable sources of information, such as official government websites and reputable news outlets, are crucial in combating the proliferation of inaccurate claims and ensuring informed public discourse. Further investigation into the actual scope and purpose of MP nº 922/2020 is essential for a comprehensive understanding of its role in the Brazilian legal and economic landscape.

## Global Race to Develop Vaccine Underway Amid Ongoing Virus Threat

A recent fact-check highlighted the crucial detail that a vaccine against the identified virus was not yet available at the time of its publication. This underscores the ongoing global effort to combat the virus and mitigate its impact. While no approved vaccine currently exists, laboratories around the world are engaged in intensive research and development, seeking to produce an effective and safe preventative measure.

The absence of a vaccine highlights the urgency and complexity of the situation. Vaccine development is a multifaceted process that typically involves several stages, including preclinical research, clinical trials, and regulatory review. These stages are designed to ensure the safety and efficacy of the vaccine before it can be widely administered.

The fact that numerous laboratories are pursuing different approaches to vaccine development signifies the global commitment to finding a solution. These research teams are exploring various technologies and platforms, each with its own potential advantages and challenges. Different vaccine candidates are being developed, some utilizing weakened or inactivated forms of the virus, while others focus on viral proteins or genetic material to stimulate an immune response.

The race to develop a vaccine is driven by the imperative to protect public health and prevent further spread of the virus. A successful vaccine would offer a critical tool in controlling the pandemic, potentially reducing the severity of infections, preventing hospitalizations, and ultimately saving lives. However, experts caution that the development and approval process takes time, and rigorous testing is essential to ensure safety and effectiveness. The international scientific community is collaborating and sharing information to expedite the process while maintaining the highest standards of scientific rigor. The progress of these efforts remains a top priority for global health organizations and governments worldwide.

Meddelelsen havde til formål at dæmpe spekulationen om, at en mulig tjenestestopp blev overvejet. En sådan suspendering ville have betydelige konsekvenser for både Uber-kørere, som afhænger af platformen til indkomst, og for brugere, der afhænger af den som en afgørende transportmulighed.

Selvom pressemeddelelsen bekræftede Uber's forpligtelse til at forblive i drift, er det sandsynligvis, at selskabet samtidig implementerer forbedrede sikkerhedsforanstaltninger og hygieneprotokoller for at mindske risikoen for virusoverførsel i bilene. Mange ride-hailing-tjenester i hele verden har allerede taget skridt som at give kørere desinfektionssprængler og anbefale passager at prioritere betaling uden penge.

Den fortsatte tilgængelighed af Uber i Brasilien vil sandsynligvis give en vis stabilitet og tilgængelighed til transportmuligheder, især for dem, der ikke kan eller vil bruge offentlig transport under pandemien. Dog skal brugere fortsat være opmærksomme og overholde offentlige sundhedsanvisninger, herunder at holde afstand og bære maske, når det er muligt, for at minimere risikoen for infektion under brug af ride-sharing-tjenester. Situationen omkring koronaviruset ændrer sig konstant, og Uber's fortsatte drift vil sandsynligvis afhænge af regler fra myndighederne og den overordnede udvikling af pandemien i Brasilien. Eventuelle ændringer i deres tjenesteproduktion vil sandsynligvis kommunikeres gennem officielle kanaler.

## Atacadão Denies Viral Donation Post, Cites Errors in Portuguese

A social media post claiming that the wholesale supermarket chain Atacadão was making a significant donation has been refuted by the company. In a statement issued via email to news outlets, Atacadão's press office confirmed that the company is not engaged in the alleged donation program.

The statement comes in response to a viral online message circulating across various platforms, purporting to offer assistance or supplies from Atacadão. While the exact content of the misleading post varies, all versions share a common claim: Atacadão is offering some form of charitable contribution.

Adding weight to the company's denial is the fact that the viral message contains noticeable errors in Portuguese. While Atacadão's press office declined to specify the exact nature of these errors, their presence further undermines the credibility of the post and supports the company's assertion that it is a fabrication. This detail highlights the importance of carefully examining the language and grammar of online content, especially when dealing with claims of official announcements or charitable offers.

The rapid spread of misinformation on social media has become an increasing concern, particularly when it involves large corporations and potential charitable initiatives. Atacadão's swift response to the false post underscores the importance of companies proactively addressing online rumors and clarifying their position to prevent public confusion. Consumers are urged to rely on official Atacadão channels, such as their website and official social media accounts, for accurate information and to exercise caution when encountering unsolicited offers or announcements circulating online. Checking for clear and correct language is one simple way to help verify a post's authenticity.

## Ministry of Health Reaffirms: Anise Tea is Not a Substitute for Antiviral Medication Against COVID-19

In a statement addressing persistent misinformation, the Ministry of Health has reiterated that traditional remedies like anise tea are not effective treatments for COVID-19 and should not be used in place of established medical interventions. The reaffirmation comes amid ongoing public discussion and, in some cases, promotion of alternative therapies in response to the ongoing pandemic.

The Ministry's message is clear: anise tea, while a popular beverage with potential health benefits, does not contain the "same substance" as antiviral medications like Tamiflu, which is specifically designed to combat influenza viruses. These medications work by targeting and inhibiting viral replication, thereby reducing the severity and duration of the illness. Herbal remedies, on the other hand, lack the specific, scientifically-proven mechanisms of action required to effectively combat the SARS-CoV-2 virus, which causes COVID-19.

"No type of tea should be used for the treatment of the new coronavirus," the Ministry of Health emphasized in its official statement. This warning is crucial to preventing individuals from relying on unproven remedies and potentially delaying or forgoing necessary medical care. Delaying proper medical treatment can lead to complications and a worsened prognosis for individuals infected with COVID-19, particularly those at higher risk due to age or underlying health conditions.

While some may find comfort in traditional remedies, the Ministry underscores the importance of relying on evidence-based treatments recommended by healthcare professionals. Individuals experiencing symptoms of COVID-19 are strongly encouraged to seek medical attention and follow the guidelines provided by health authorities, including testing, vaccination, and the use of approved antiviral medications where appropriate. The focus should remain on utilizing proven medical interventions to protect public health and mitigate the impact of the pandemic.

**UK Media Outlets Briefly Circulate Misleading Air Pollution Map**

Several prominent UK news publications, including the *Daily Mail*, *The Sun*, and *Metro*, recently published a map purportedly showing real-time air pollution levels across Europe. However, the information presented in these maps has been revealed to be inaccurate and not based on real-time satellite data as initially implied.

The images, since removed from the publications' websites, originated from a meteorological forecasting website. This website utilizes historical data to predict the concentration of pollutant gases, essentially providing a forecast rather than a live snapshot of current air quality. The key distinction lies in the fact that the map depicted predicted pollution levels based on past trends and algorithms, not on actual measurements taken from satellites or ground-based monitoring stations at the time of publication.

The spread of the map highlights the potential for misinformation to proliferate rapidly through digital channels. While weather forecasting websites often provide valuable insights into potential environmental conditions, it is crucial that news outlets accurately represent the nature and source of the data being presented. In this instance, the failure to clearly identify the predictive nature of the map resulted in a misleading representation of current air pollution levels being disseminated to a wide audience.

The incident serves as a reminder of the importance of verifying the accuracy and sourcing of information, particularly visual data such as maps and charts, before publishing. As environmental awareness grows and the public increasingly relies on online sources for information, responsible reporting and careful fact-checking are essential to ensure that citizens are well-informed about environmental issues and potential health risks.

## Unverified Reports of Surging Infections and Deaths in China Circulate Online

Social media has been awash with claims of an exponential increase in COVID-19 infections and deaths within China. These reports, painting a grim picture of the current situation, are largely sourced from a text published on a website associated with the Hal Turner radio program. The text in question details specific, alarming figures concerning the supposed surge.

However, it's crucial to approach these claims with significant caution. As of yet, no official sources, be they within the Chinese government or internationally recognized health organizations, have corroborated the information presented. The figures cited in the Hal Turner program's post remain unverified and stand in stark contrast to the data publicly available from official channels.

The dissemination of unverified information, particularly regarding public health crises, can have significant consequences. It can contribute to heightened anxiety, misinformation, and potentially harmful decisions driven by inaccurate data. It is paramount to rely on trustworthy and verifiable sources when seeking information about the COVID-19 situation, or any significant global health event.

While independent verification of information coming from China can often be challenging, the lack of any supporting evidence from official sources, coupled with the source's association with a controversial figure like Hal Turner, raises serious doubts about the veracity of the claims. Individuals are strongly encouraged to critically evaluate the information they encounter online and to rely on reputable news organizations and official government health agencies for accurate and updated information regarding the pandemic. Continuously depending on official data is paramount during a public health crisis to avoid fueling unnecessary panic.

## Viral Claim: Garlic-Infused Water Not a COVID-19 Cure

A social media post claiming that a specific concoction of garlic-infused water can cure COVID-19 is circulating online. The post asserts that boiling seven cups of water with eight chopped garlic cloves provides a remedy against the SARS-CoV-2 virus, the virus responsible for the COVID-19 pandemic.

While garlic is known for its potential health benefits, particularly its antimicrobial properties, there is currently no scientific evidence to support the claim that this specific recipe is effective against COVID-19. Health organizations and medical experts strongly caution against relying on unproven remedies and treatments during the pandemic.

The spread of misinformation regarding COVID-19 cures and treatments has been a persistent problem since the beginning of the pandemic. Such claims can be dangerous, as they may lead individuals to forgo seeking appropriate medical care or potentially harmful self-treatment methods.

Public health officials consistently emphasize the importance of relying on credible sources of information, such as the World Health Organization (WHO) and national health agencies like the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). These organizations provide the most up-to-date information on prevention measures, testing, treatment options, and vaccine development related to COVID-19.

While dietary supplements and certain foods may contribute to overall well-being and a healthy immune system, they should not be considered a replacement for proven medical interventions. Individuals experiencing symptoms of COVID-19 should immediately consult with a qualified healthcare professional to receive accurate diagnosis and appropriate treatment. It is crucial to be vigilant and critical of health-related information shared on social media and to prioritize evidence-based medical advice.

## Ministry of Health Clarifies: Vitamin C Not Recommended for COVID-19 Prevention

Recent online discussions regarding COVID-19 prevention have prompted the Ministerio de Salud (Ministry of Health) to issue a clear statement: Vitamin C consumption is not among the recommended measures to prevent the virus. The clarification aims to address misinformation and ensure the public focuses on evidence-based strategies to protect themselves from infection.

While Vitamin C is an essential nutrient that plays a crucial role in supporting the immune system, particularly in its antioxidant functions and cell protection, the Ministry of Health has stated unequivocally that relying on it as a primary prevention method against COVID-19 is not supported by scientific evidence.

This announcement comes amidst continued public interest in potential preventative measures against the ongoing pandemic. Many individuals are actively seeking ways to bolster their immune systems and reduce their risk of contracting the virus. However, the Ministry of Health emphasizes the importance of adhering to established preventative guidelines.

The core recommendations for COVID-19 prevention, consistently promoted by health authorities, typically include vaccination, wearing masks in appropriate settings, maintaining physical distancing, practicing diligent hand hygiene, and ensuring adequate ventilation in indoor spaces. These measures have been shown to be effective in limiting the spread of the virus and reducing the severity of illness.

The Ministry of Health's statement serves as a reminder to the public to rely on credible sources of information regarding COVID-19 and to avoid placing undue reliance on unsubstantiated claims. It is important to consult with healthcare professionals for personalized advice and to stay informed about the latest official guidelines and recommendations from recognized health organizations. This proactive approach is crucial in navigating the ongoing challenges posed by the pandemic and prioritizing public health safety.

## Сауықтық министрлігі түсіндіреді: Витамин С көпіршік әзірлеу үшін ұсынылмайды

Көптеген интернеттегі талқылаулардың нәтижесінде көпіршік әзірлеу жөнінде әңгімелесулер үшін Сауықтық министрлігі түсіндіру жариялады: Витамин С таңдап алу көпіршік әзірлеу үшін ұсынылмайды. Бұл түсіндіру әзірлеу жөнінде жалған мағлұматтарды азайту мен жариялау жөнінде ғылыми дәлелдерге негізделген стратегияларға көңіл бөлу үшін әзірленді.

Витамин С қажетті құрылым болып табылады, ол иммунитеттің дамуына үлкен үлес қосады, әсіресе антиоксиданттық қызметтері мен ұлпа қорғауын қамтамасыз етеді. Бірақ Сауықтық министрлігі ғылыми дәлелдерге негізделмейтін көпіршік әзірлеу әдісі ретінде оны қолдануға қарсылық жасады.

Бұл жариялау жалпы көпіршік әзірлеу әдістерінен қызығушылықтың жалғасында болып отыр. Көптеген адамдар көпіршік әзірлеу және көпіршікке ұшырау қауіпін азайту үшін өз иммунитеттерін күшейтуге ұмтылады. Бірақ Сауықтық министрлігі ғылыми дәлелдерге негізделген қорғау әдістерін сақтау әріптесінің маңыздылығын анықтайды.

Көпіршік әзірлеу үшін негізгі ұсыныстар, жариялау әріптесінің біртұрақты ұсыныстарында ұсынылады, бұлар көпіршіктің таралуын шектеу және аурудың тежелуін азайту үшін әсер етеді. Бұл әдістер көпіршік әзірлеу және аурудың тежелуін күшейтуге қолайлы.

Сауықтық министрлігінің жариялауы көпіршік әзірлеу жөнінде ғылыми дәлелдерге негізделген мағлұматтарды пайдалануға құрылған қаралып, жалған сөйлемдерге үлкен қадам жасауға болмайтындығын есте сақтау үшін қызметкерлерге ұсынылады. Медициналық қызметкерлермен әзірлеу жөнінде күндізгі жетістіктерге қатысты ұсыныстар мен ұсыныстарды қадағалау әріптесінің маңыздылығын есте сақтау керек. Бұл әдістемелер көпіршік әзірлеу және қоғамдық саулықтың қауіпсіздігін қамтамасыз ету үшін маңызды.
article_summary: El Ministerio de Salud aclaró que el consumo de vitamina C no es recomendado para prevenir el COVID-19, desmintiendo rumores y enfatizando medidas basadas en evidencia. ## Israeli Lab Developing Potential COVID-19 Vaccine, But Human Trials Still Distant

Reports are circulating regarding a potential vaccine for the novel coronavirus (COVID-19) being developed in Israel. While these reports offer a glimmer of hope in the global fight against the pandemic, it is crucial to understand the current stage of development.

According to sources, an Israeli laboratory is actively engaged in research and development efforts aimed at producing a vaccine against the virus that has caused widespread disruption and fatalities worldwide. The exact identity of the laboratory has not been widely publicized, likely due to the preliminary nature of the work.

However, the key takeaway is that the potential vaccine is still in its early stages. It is not yet ready for widespread distribution or even clinical trials. Crucially, the substance has not yet been tested on human subjects. This is a critical stage in vaccine development, as animal testing and pre-clinical trials are essential to assess safety and efficacy before human trials can even be considered.

The development of a new vaccine is a complex and time-consuming process. It typically involves several phases, starting with research and development, followed by pre-clinical testing (often on animals), and then moving on to various phases of human clinical trials. These trials are designed to evaluate the vaccine's safety, dosage, and effectiveness in preventing the targeted disease.

While the news of an Israeli laboratory working on a potential COVID-19 vaccine is encouraging, it's important to manage expectations. The road to a viable and widely available vaccine is often long and arduous, with no guarantee of success. Extensive research, rigorous testing, and regulatory approval are all essential steps before a vaccine can be considered safe and effective for widespread use. The world remains engaged in a race against time to develop effective treatments and preventative measures for COVID-19, and the work being conducted in Israel, while promising, represents just one part of this ongoing global effort.

## Debunking Claims of a Pre-Existing COVID-19 Patent

Social media has been abuzz with claims that a patent exists for COVID-19, suggesting a pre-planned pandemic scenario. However, these claims stem from a misunderstanding of existing patents related to coronaviruses. While a patent *does* exist, it relates to a weakened strain of the Infectious Bronchitis Virus (IBV), a coronavirus that primarily affects birds.

Infectious Bronchitis Virus is a highly contagious avian disease impacting poultry, causing respiratory problems and significant economic losses in the agricultural sector. Research into IBV has been ongoing for decades, leading to the development of vaccines and other control measures. These efforts often involve creating attenuated, or weakened, versions of the virus.

The patent in question likely covers one such attenuated strain. Attenuation is a common technique in vaccine development, where the disease-causing capacity of a virus or bacterium is weakened to create immunity without causing serious illness. These weakened strains allow the immune system to recognize and develop defenses against the real, virulent pathogen.

Therefore, the existence of a patent related to an attenuated IBV coronavirus should not be interpreted as evidence of a pre-existing patent for SARS-CoV-2, the virus that causes COVID-19. IBV is a distinct virus that primarily infects avian species and poses no direct threat to humans. While both are coronaviruses, they belong to different branches of the coronavirus family and exhibit significant genetic differences.

The confusion likely arises from the shared "coronavirus" designation. Coronaviruses are a large family of viruses, encompassing a wide range of pathogens affecting various animal species, including humans. While SARS-CoV-2 and IBV are both members of this family, they are distinct entities with different hosts and effects.

It's crucial to distinguish between research and development efforts on various coronaviruses and the specific emergence and subsequent research into SARS-CoV-2. Claims suggesting a pre-planned pandemic based on existing IBV patents are misleading and contribute to the spread of misinformation. Understanding the differences between these viruses and the context surrounding vaccine development is vital for accurate public discourse.

Social medier har været i høj grad aktive med påstande om, at der findes et patent for COVID-19, hvilket antyder et forudplanlagt pandemisk scenario. Dog skyldes disse påstande en fejlforståelse af eksisterende patenter relateret til koronavirusser. Selvom der findes et patent, drejer det sig om en svækket stamme af Infectious Bronchitis Virus (IBV), et koronavirus, der primært påvirker fugle.

Infectious Bronchitis Virus er en højligt smittsom fuglepest, der påvirker poulag, og forårsager respiratoriske problemer samt betydelige økonomiske tab i landbrugssektoren. Forskning til IBV har været i gang i årtier, hvilket har ført til udvikling af vacciner og andre kontrolmidler. Disse anstrengelser indebærer ofte skabelse af svækkede, eller svækkede, versioner af virusset.

Det pågældende patent omfatter sandsynligvis netop en sådan svækket stamme. Svækkelse er en almindelig teknik i vaccinudvikling, hvor virussets eller bakteriens sygdomsforårsagende evne bliver svækket, så man opnår immunitet uden at forårsage alvorlig sygdom. Disse svækkede stammer tillader det immunesystem at genkende og udvikle forsvar mod det rigtige, virulente patogen.

Derfor bør eksistensen af et patent relateret til en svækket IBV-koronavirus ikke fortolkes som bevis på et forudgående patent for SARS-CoV-2, det virus, der forårsager COVID-19. IBV er et anderledes virus, der primært inficerer fugle og ikke direkte truer mennesker. Selvom begge er koronavirusser, tilhører de forskellige grene i koronavirusfamilien og viser betydelige genetiske forskelle.

Forvirringen skyldes sandsynligvis den fælles betegnelse "koronavirus". Koronavirusser er en stor familie af virusser, der omfatter en bred vifte af patogener, der påvirker forskellige dyrearter, herunder mennesker. Selvom både SARS-CoV-2 og IBV er medlemmer af denne familie, er de forskellige entiteter med forskellige værtsspecifikke effekter.

Det er afgørende at skelne mellem forskning og udvikling på forskellige koronavirusser og den specifikke opståen og efterfølgende forskning på SARS-CoV-2. Påstande om, at pandemien var forudplanlagt baseret på eksisterende IBV-patenter, er misvisende og bidrager til spredning af fejlinformation. For at sikre præcis offentlig debat er det vigtigt at forstå forskellene mellem disse virusser og konteksten omkring vaccinudvikling.

## Coronavirus Strain Detected in Brazilian Patient Differs from Chinese Variant

Recent reports circulating online have highlighted the identification of a coronavirus in a patient at the Hospital São Domingos in São Luís, Brazil. However, crucial context clarifies that this strain is distinct from the variant currently causing concern and being monitored globally after its emergence in China.

While both are coronaviruses, a broad family of viruses known to cause illnesses ranging from the common cold to more severe diseases like SARS and MERS, they represent different branches of the viral family tree. The recent identification at the São Domingos Hospital, while confirming the presence of a coronavirus infection, does *not* indicate an outbreak of the new Chinese variant in Brazil.

The statement emphasizes a key distinction often overlooked in discussions about viruses and outbreaks. The term "coronavirus" describes a family, not a single, uniform threat. Just as different strains of influenza exist, so too do different types of coronaviruses, each with its own characteristics, transmissibility, and potential severity.

This distinction is important to prevent unnecessary panic and to ensure public health resources are directed appropriately. Identifying the specific strain of coronavirus is crucial for understanding the nature of the infection, implementing targeted treatment strategies, and accurately assessing the potential risk to the community.

While details about the specific strain identified at Hospital São Domingos remain limited in public information, the fundamental point is clear: the coronavirus detected is not the same as the variant currently impacting China. Further investigations are likely underway to fully characterize the Brazilian strain and understand its implications for public health locally.

## Brazil's Migration Law Faces Criticism Over Border Control Ambiguity

Brazil's Migration Law, officially designated as Law No. 13.445/2017, has come under scrutiny for its perceived lack of clarity regarding the country's approach to border control. While the legislation established a framework for the rights and responsibilities of migrants within Brazil, it notably omits specific guidelines and directives for managing and regulating the nation's extensive borders.

This omission has sparked debate and raised concerns among legal scholars and policymakers. The law, intended to modernize Brazil's migration policies and align them with international human rights standards, primarily focuses on ensuring the fair treatment of immigrants already present within the country. It addresses issues such as regularization, access to public services, and the integration of migrants into Brazilian society.

However, the absence of specific provisions addressing border security and control leaves a significant gap in the overall migration management framework. Critics argue that the law's silence on this crucial aspect creates ambiguity and potential challenges for border security personnel in determining appropriate procedures for entry, surveillance, and the handling of individuals attempting to cross the border irregularly.

The lack of a clearly defined border control policy also raises questions about Brazil's ability to effectively combat transnational crime, including human trafficking and smuggling, which often occurs along its borders. Without explicit legal guidelines, agencies responsible for border security may face difficulties in coordinating their efforts and implementing consistent practices.

The debate surrounding the Migration Law's perceived deficiency highlights the complex and multifaceted nature of migration policy. While ensuring the protection and integration of migrants is essential, a comprehensive approach must also address the practical aspects of border management to ensure national security and orderly migration flows. As Brazil continues to navigate the complexities of migration in the 21st century, the need for a clearer and more comprehensive legal framework regarding border control is likely to remain a critical point of discussion.

A fabricated story claiming publication by a Brazilian newspaper is currently spreading online, prompting warnings about the dangers of misinformation and the importance of verifying sources before sharing information. The claim, presented in a recent viral tweet, features a doctored image purporting to show a news article headline.

The central claim circulating is that a prominent Brazilian newspaper published a specific piece of information, but investigations have confirmed this is false. The Brazilian newspaper in question has not released any statement confirming the content.

The misinformation is amplified by the use of a manipulated image. This fabricated image, designed to mimic the look and feel of a genuine news article, is the primary vehicle through which the false story is being spread. The act of creating and disseminating such fabricated images highlights the evolving sophistication of misinformation campaigns.

This incident serves as a stark reminder of the need for increased media literacy and critical thinking skills in the digital age. Individuals are urged to be vigilant when encountering potentially inflammatory or surprising news items online. Simple steps like checking the source's website directly, cross-referencing the information with other reputable news outlets, and utilizing fact-checking resources can significantly reduce the spread of false information.

The origin and intention behind this particular instance of misinformation remain unclear. However, regardless of the motivation, the incident underscores the potential for manipulated content to quickly gain traction and impact public opinion. It is crucial for individuals to take responsibility for the information they share and contribute to a more informed and accurate online environment.

## Experts Debunk Claim That Holding Breath Prevents Coronavirus Diagnosis

A viral claim circulating on social media, suggesting that the ability to hold one's breath for over 10 seconds without coughing is sufficient to rule out a COVID-19 infection, has been widely debunked by medical professionals. The assertion, shared in multiple languages across various platforms, incorrectly promotes a self-diagnostic method that lacks any scientific backing.

The core of the false claim revolves around the idea that COVID-19 damages lung tissue, preventing individuals with the virus from holding their breath for a significant duration. Proponents of the theory argue that a successful breath-holding test, characterized by the absence of coughing, indicates healthy lung function and therefore excludes the possibility of infection.

However, medical experts strongly refute this notion. While COVID-19 can indeed affect the lungs and cause respiratory issues, the ability to hold one's breath is influenced by numerous factors unrelated to the virus. These factors include age, overall fitness level, pre-existing respiratory conditions, and even the individual's technique during the test.

Furthermore, many individuals infected with COVID-19 may experience only mild or asymptomatic cases, meaning they may not exhibit any noticeable symptoms, including difficulty breathing or coughing. Relying solely on a breath-holding test would provide a false sense of security and potentially lead to the further spread of the virus by undiagnosed individuals.

## Federal Highway Police Clarifies: Hand Sanitizer Will Not Trigger Breathalyzer Tests

Buenos Aires, Argentina - Amidst widespread adoption of hand sanitizers as a preventative measure against Covid-19, the Federal Highway Police (Policía Caminera Federal) has issued a clarification regarding breathalyzer tests and alcohol-based hand sanitizers. The agency has officially stated that the use of hand sanitizer, specifically the alcohol-based gels widely recommended for preventing the spread of the virus, will *not* register a positive reading during breathalyzer tests (etilómetro).

This announcement aims to alleviate concerns among drivers who frequently use hand sanitizers, particularly those working in transportation and delivery services, about potentially failing roadside alcohol checks. With the mandatory use of hand sanitizer in many public spaces and workplaces, drivers had expressed worry that residual alcohol on their hands or within the vehicle could inadvertently trigger a positive breathalyzer result, leading to unnecessary stops, investigations, and potential penalties.

The Policía Caminera Federal sought to address these anxieties directly, emphasizing the scientific basis of breathalyzer technology. Breathalyzers are designed to measure the concentration of alcohol in exhaled air, which reflects the level of alcohol circulating in the bloodstream. While hand sanitizers contain alcohol, it is applied topically and evaporates quickly, with minimal absorption into the bloodstream. Consequently, its use does not significantly impact the breath alcohol concentration levels that would be detected by a properly calibrated breathalyzer.

This clarification is particularly important in Argentina, where driving under the influence laws are strictly enforced, and breathalyzer tests are a routine part of traffic enforcement. The Federal Highway Police hopes that this statement will provide reassurance to drivers and prevent unnecessary delays or legal complications related to hand sanitizer use. While hand sanitizer use is encouraged for public health, drivers are reminded to always adhere to the legal alcohol limits and to drive responsibly. The police reiterated their commitment to road safety and emphasized that the primary goal of breathalyzer tests is to deter drunk driving, not to penalize individuals for practicing good hygiene.

## پلیس جاده‌ای فدرال توضیح داد: مایع دست‌کش نمی‌تواند تست اتیلومتر را فعال کند

بوئنوس آیرس، آرژانتین - در حالی که استفاده گسترده از مایع دست‌کش به عنوان یک اقدام پیشگیرانه در برابر کووید-19 افزایش یافته است، پلیس جاده‌ای فدرال (Policía Caminera Federal) توضیحی درباره تست اتیلومتر و مایع دست‌کش مبتنی بر الکل صادر کرده است. این نهاد به رسمیت اعلام کرده است که استفاده از مایع دست‌کش، به خصوص ژل‌های الکلی که به طور گسترده برای جلوگیری از پخش ویروس توصیه می‌شوند، به طور میلیونی به نتیجه مثبت تست اتیلومتر (etilómetro) نمی‌رسد.

این اعلام به منظور کاهش نگرانی‌های رانندگانی که مایع دست‌کش را به طور مداوم استفاده می‌کنند، به ویژه کارگران حمل و نقل و خدمات تحویل، درباره احتمال شکست در تست‌های الکلی در جاده‌ها است. با اینکه استفاده اجباری از مایع دست‌کش در بسیاری از فضاها عمومی و محل کار وجود دارد، رانندگان نگران بودند که الکل باقی‌مانده روی دست‌های خود یا در داخل خودرو می‌تواند به طور اتفاقی نتیجه مثبت تست اتیلومتر را ایجاد کند و این امر منجر به توقف‌های غیرضروری، بررسی‌های قانونی و مجازات‌های احتمالی شود.

پلیس جاده‌ای فدرال به منظور رسیدن به این نگرانی‌ها به طور مستقیم و بر پایه اساس علمی تست اتیلومتر اقدام کرده است. تست‌های اتیلومتر برای اندازه‌گیری غلظت الکل در هوا خارج شده از دهان طراحی شده‌اند که بازتاب سطح الکل در خون است. هر چند مایع دست‌کش الکل دارد، اما به صورت محلی استفاده می‌شود و به سریع تبخیر می‌شود، با کمترین جذب در خون. بنابراین، استفاده از آن تأثیر قابل توجهی بر غلظت الکل در هوا خارج شده از دهان ندارد که به وسیله یک تست اتیلومتر به درستی تنظیم شده تشخیص داده می‌شود.

این توضیح به ویژه در آرژانتین مهم است، که قوانین رانندگی تحت تأثیر الکل به شدت اجرا می‌شود و تست اتیلومتر به عنوان بخشی معمولی از اجرای قوانین ترافیک در نظر گرفته می‌شود. پلیس جاده‌ای فدرال امیدوار است که این اعلان به رانندگان اطمینان بدهد و بازداری از تاخیرهای غیرضروری یا مسائل قانونی مرتبط با استفاده از مایع دست‌کش را به انجام برساند. در حالی که استفاده از مایع دست‌کش برای بهبود سلامت عمومی تشویق می‌شود، رانندگان به یاد داشته باشند که محدودیت‌های قانونی الکل را به طور کامل رعایت کنند و مسافرت‌های خود را با مسئولیت‌پذیری انجام دهند. پلیس مجدد از承诺 خود به امنیت جاده‌ها اطمینان داد و تأکید کرد که اصل اصلی تست اتیلومتر جلوگیری از رانندگی خواب آلود است، نه مجازات افرادی که بهداشت خوب را رعایت می‌کنند.

## Misconception Alert: Coronavirus Does Not Die at Mild Temperatures

**Recent social media posts claiming the novel coronavirus, SARS-CoV-2, is killed at temperatures of 26 or 27 degrees Celsius (approximately 79-81 degrees Fahrenheit) are inaccurate and potentially dangerous, according to health experts.** While temperature can influence the viability of the virus, simply experiencing a mild, warm day does not eliminate the risk of infection.

The World Health Organization (WHO) and other leading public health institutions have repeatedly emphasized that the virus can survive in a range of temperatures and climates. Laboratory studies have shown that SARS-CoV-2 is sensitive to heat, with higher temperatures (above 56 degrees Celsius, or 133 degrees Fahrenheit) and prolonged exposure required to effectively inactivate it. However, these are laboratory conditions far removed from the typical ambient temperatures experienced in most environments.

The misconception likely stems from confusion regarding the virus's behavior and spread. While warmer, drier weather *may* have a limited impact on transmission rates in certain situations – potentially reducing the amount of time the virus remains viable on surfaces or in the air – it doesn't eliminate the need for preventative measures. Factors like humidity, UV exposure, and surface type all play a role in how long the virus can remain infectious.

The continued reliance on measures such as frequent handwashing with soap and water, wearing masks in public, maintaining physical distancing, and avoiding crowded spaces remains crucial regardless of the temperature. Relying on the belief that mild temperatures offer protection against the virus could lead to complacency and increased risk of infection.

Health authorities urge the public to consult credible sources like the WHO, national health agencies, and reputable medical journals for accurate and up-to-date information about COVID-19 and how to protect themselves and others. Avoiding the spread of misinformation is just as important as preventing the spread of the virus itself.

## Hibás megértés figyelmeztetés: a koronavírus nem hal meg enyhe hőmérsékleten

**A közösségi média újabb híre, miszerint a SARS-CoV-2 új koronavírus a 26 vagy 27 Celsius-fokos (körülbelül 79–81 Fahrenheit-fokos) hőmérsékleten meghal, pontatlan és potenciálisan veszélyes, ezeket a kijelentéseket egészségügyi szakértők szerint.** Bár a hőmérséklet befolyásolhatja a vírus életképességét, az enyhe, meleg nappal nem eltávolítja az fertőzés kockázatát.

A Világszervezet Egészségügyi Szervezete (WHO) és más vezető közegészségügyi intézmények ismételten hangsúlyozta, hogy a vírus számos hőmérsékleti és klímaterületen is túlélhet. Laboratóriumi vizsgálatok azt mutatták, hogy a SARS-CoV-2 érzékeny a melegre, a magasabb hőmérsékletek (56 Celsius-fok felett, azaz 133 Fahrenheit-fok felett) és hosszabb expozíció szükséges a hatékony inaktiválásához. Azonban ezek a laboratóriumi körülmények távol állnak a legtöbb környezetben tapasztalható átlagos hőmérsékletektől.

A hibás megértés valószínűleg a vírus viselkedésére és terjedésére vonatkozó téves információk miatt alakult ki. Bár a meleg, száraz idő *lehet* korlátozottan befolyásolja a terjedési arányokat bizonyos helyzetekben – ezek esetében a vírus élettartama felületen vagy levegőben valószínűleg rövidebb lehet –, nem szünteti meg a megelőző intézkedések szükségességét. A páratartalom, a UV-exponáltság és a felület típusa mind befolyásolja, hogy mennyi ideig maradhat a vírus fertőzőképes.

A gyakori kezmosás szappan és vízzel, a közterületeken való maszkviselés, a fizikai távolságtartás és a sűrűn tömött helyek elkerülése továbbra is kritikus, függetlenül a hőmérséklettől. A vírus elleni védekezésre való hitelesség hiánya, azaz a hitelesség hiánya, a vírus terjedésének növekedéséhez vezethet.

Az egészségügyi hatóságok figyelmeztetik a közönséget, hogy a WHO, az országos egészségügyi hatóságok és a megbízható orvosi folyóiratok által biztosított információkra hivatkozzanak, hogy pontos és friss információkat kapjanak a COVID-19-ről és azokról az intézkedésekről, amelyekkel megvédik magukat és másokat. A hamis információk terjedésének megakadályozása ugyanolyan fontos, mint a vírus terjedésének megakadályozása.

La confusión puede llevar a la complacencia, por lo que medidas como lavado de manos, mascarillas y distanciamiento siguen siendo esenciales independientemente de la temperatura.

## Fact Check: Image Circulating Online Shows COVID-19 Test, Not Vaccine

Social media users are sharing an image of what they believe to be a COVID-19 vaccine. However, fact-checking reveals the image depicts a test designed to detect the presence of the SARS-CoV-2 virus in the body, and not a vaccine intended to prevent infection.

The confusion likely stems from the ongoing global effort to both combat the spread of COVID-19 through testing and to develop and distribute effective vaccines. Both testing and vaccination strategies are crucial components of public health initiatives aimed at controlling the pandemic.

Tests, such as the one pictured, are designed to identify active infections, allowing individuals to isolate and prevent further transmission. These tests typically involve collecting samples, such as nasal swabs or saliva, which are then analyzed for the presence of the virus's genetic material or antigens.

Vaccines, on the other hand, work by stimulating the body's immune system to recognize and fight off the virus. They are administered to healthy individuals to provide protection against future infection.

The image circulating online likely depicts a rapid antigen test or a PCR test kit. These tests have become commonplace during the pandemic, used in a variety of settings, from hospitals and clinics to schools and workplaces, to identify individuals who are currently infected with the virus.

Misinformation surrounding COVID-19 vaccines and testing has been prevalent throughout the pandemic, leading to confusion and hesitancy. It is crucial to rely on credible sources of information, such as public health organizations like the World Health Organization (WHO) and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), to stay informed about COVID-19 and related health measures. Before sharing information online, especially related to health, it's important to verify the information with reliable sources to prevent the spread of inaccurate or misleading claims.

**Federal Chemistry Council Warns Against Dangerous Mixing of Household Chemicals**

The Federal Chemistry Council (CFQ) has issued a warning about the potentially dangerous consequences of mixing certain household cleaning products. In a recent statement, the CFQ highlighted the risk of toxic reactions, emphasizing that the seemingly harmless practice can lead to serious health problems, and in extreme cases, even death.

The CFQ's warning comes amidst ongoing efforts to educate the public on safe handling and usage of chemical substances commonly found in homes. While individual cleaning products are often formulated for specific tasks and are generally safe when used as directed, combining them can create unpredictable and hazardous chemical reactions.

The statement specifically cautions against the mixing of different cleaning agents due to the risk of generating irritating or corrosive substances. These reactions can cause irritation to the skin and mucous membranes, leading to symptoms such as burns, rashes, and difficulty breathing. Individuals with pre-existing respiratory conditions are particularly vulnerable to the harmful effects of inhaling toxic fumes produced from mixing chemicals.

Beyond mild irritations, the CFQ emphasizes the potential for more severe consequences. Depending on the chemicals involved and the concentration of the resulting reaction, mixing cleaning products can generate highly toxic gases or liquids that can lead to serious internal injuries, permanent damage to the respiratory system, and even death.

The CFQ's advice to consumers is clear: always read and follow the instructions on the labels of all cleaning products. Never mix different products together, and ensure adequate ventilation when using any cleaning agent. In case of accidental mixing or exposure to potentially harmful fumes, seek immediate medical attention. The Federal Chemistry Council hopes that increased awareness of these dangers will help prevent accidents and ensure the safe use of chemical products in households nationwide.

## Video Circulating Online Predates First Confirmed COVID-19 Case in Brazil

A video currently circulating online purportedly depicting the early days of the COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil has sparked debate about the country's initial response to the global health crisis. However, investigations reveal the video dates back to January 30th, a period *before* the first confirmed case of the novel coronavirus was registered within Brazilian borders.

While the content of the video remains unconfirmed and its veracity is still under scrutiny, the timestamp provides crucial context. On January 30th, 2020, the World Health Organization (WHO) had already declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to the emerging outbreak, primarily centered in Wuhan, China. However, the impact on the South American continent was still considered relatively minimal.

Brazil's first officially recorded case of COVID-19 wasn't confirmed until February 26th, 2020, in São Paulo. This case involved a traveler returning from Italy, which was then experiencing a significant surge in infections. Prior to this confirmation, health authorities across Brazil were actively monitoring potential cases and implementing initial screening measures at airports and ports of entry.

Therefore, understanding the timeline is critical when interpreting the content of the video. If the footage indeed originates from January 30th, as claimed, it offers a glimpse into a period of heightened awareness and anticipation, but *not* a reaction to widespread transmission within the country. The video might reflect early preventative measures, anxieties related to the global outbreak, or perhaps simply routine occurrences unrelated to the impending pandemic.

The circulation of this video highlights the importance of verifying information and considering the context in which it was created, especially during times of heightened public concern. Misinformation and the spread of dated material can easily contribute to confusion and misinterpretations about the timeline and impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil. Further investigation into the video's content and origin remains necessary to determine its true significance.

## Comparing COVID-19 and H1N1: A Premature Analysis

The rapid spread of the novel coronavirus (COVID-19) has naturally drawn comparisons to past pandemics, most notably the H1N1 influenza pandemic of 2009. However, experts caution against drawing definitive parallels between the two outbreaks, arguing that the current data doesn't support a like-for-like comparison.

A crucial point often overlooked in casual discussions is the timeframe over which the H1N1 cases accumulated. While it's true that over 58,000 infections were attributed to the H1N1 virus, this figure represents the total number of cases recorded over a period exceeding a year and a half.

In contrast, the number of confirmed COVID-19 cases, while rapidly growing, represents the total count within a significantly shorter period, often within a single month, depending on when the statement was made. This difference in timeframe is critical because it impacts the perceived rate of infection and the overall trajectory of the outbreak.

Comparing raw case numbers without considering the duration of the outbreaks paints an incomplete picture. Factors such as testing capacity, public health responses, and the inherent transmissibility of each virus all play a significant role in shaping the spread of the disease. To accurately compare the two, epidemiologists would need to examine more complex metrics, such as the reproduction number (R0) of each virus, adjusted for different periods and populations, alongside comprehensive mortality data.

Therefore, while learning from the past experiences of dealing with pandemics like H1N1 is essential, drawing simplistic comparisons based solely on raw case numbers during the initial phases of an outbreak can be misleading and potentially harmful. A more nuanced and data-driven approach is crucial for understanding the true scope and potential impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

એક મહત્વપૂર્ણ બિંદુ જે અસામાન્ય ચર્ચાઓમાં અવગણિત રહે છે, એ એચ1એન1 કેસની સંખ્યાઓ સંગ્રહિત કરવાની સમયગાળા છે. આ સાચું છે કે એચ1એન1 વાયરસના કારણે 58,000 કેસ નોંધાયા હતા, પરંતુ આ સંખ્યા એક વર્ષ અને અડધા વર્ષથી વધુ સમયગાળા માટે નોંધાયેલા કેસની કુલ સંખ્યાનું પ્રતિનિધિત્વ કરે છે.

બદલામાં, કોવિડ-19 કેસની સંખ્યા, છતાં તે ઝડપથી વધી રહી છે, તે એક મહિનાથી ઓછા સમયગાળા માટે નોંધાયેલા કેસની કુલ સંખ્યાનું પ્રતિનિધિત્વ કરે છે, જે સૂચનાની સમયગાળા પર આધારિત હોઈ શકે છે. આ સમયગાળાનો તફાવત મહત્વપૂર્ણ છે કારણ કે તે સંક્રમણ દરની સમજૂતી અને મહામારીના સમગ્ર માર્ગની પ્રવૃત્તિને પ્રભાવિત કરે છે.

સમયગાળાની બાહેર કેસની સંખ્યાની તુલના કરવી એ એક અપૂર્ણ ચિત્ર બનાવે છે. પરીક્ષણ ક્ષમતા, સામાજિક આયુષ્ય પ્રતિસાદ અને દરેક વાયરસની સ્વાભાવિક પ્રસરણ ક્ષમતા જેવા કારકો રોગની પ્રસરણ માટે મહત્વપૂર્ણ ભૂમિકા ભજવે છે. બંનેની સાચી તુલના કરવા માટે પ્રાણીશાસ્ત્રશાસ્ત્રીઓને વધુ જટિલ �મેટ્રિક્સની જરૂર હોય છે, જેમાં દરેક વાયરસનો પ્રારંભિક સંખ્યા (R0) અને વિવિધ સમયગાળા અને જનસંખ્યાઓ માટે સમાયેલ મૃત્યુ ડેટા સાથે સંબંધિત હોય છે.

તેથી, જો કે એચ1એન1 જેવી મહામારીઓની સામે લડવાની પૂર્વિય અનુભવોથી શીખવાની આવશ્યકતા છે, પરંતુ મહામારીના પ્રારંભિક તબક્કામાં સામાન્ય કેસ સંખ્યાઓ પર આધારિત સરળ તુલના ગુંડાફેય અને સંભવિત નુકસાન પ્રદાન કરી શકે છે. મહામારીની સાચી વિસ્તાર અને સંભાવિત પ્રભાવની સમજ માટે એક સૂક્ષ્મ અને ડેટા આધારિત પ્રાથમિકતા મહત્વપૂર્ણ છે.

**Old Photo Misattributed to COVID-19 Crisis Circulating Online**

A photograph that has been circulating online, falsely attributed to the current COVID-19 crisis, is in fact an older image unrelated to the pandemic, fact-checkers have confirmed. The dissemination of this image highlights the ongoing challenge of combating misinformation during a global health crisis.

The post in question, which went viral across various social media platforms, paired the photograph with claims suggesting it depicted scenes of suffering or impact related to the coronavirus outbreak. However, a careful analysis of the photograph by several independent fact-checking organizations revealed that the image predates the COVID-19 pandemic.

While the origins of the photograph remain unclear, initial investigations indicate that it has been circulating online for a considerable period, potentially related to a different crisis or event. The re-emergence of the photo, coupled with a false narrative linking it to COVID-19, illustrates how outdated content can be repurposed and weaponized to spread disinformation.

The deliberate misattribution of images is a common tactic employed by individuals seeking to sow discord, spread fear, or promote specific agendas during times of uncertainty. In the context of the COVID-19 pandemic, such misinformation can have serious consequences, potentially undermining public health efforts and eroding trust in credible sources of information.

This incident serves as a crucial reminder of the importance of critical thinking and media literacy when consuming information online, particularly during fast-evolving situations such as the COVID-19 pandemic. Individuals are encouraged to verify information with trusted sources, consult fact-checking websites, and exercise caution before sharing content that has not been independently verified. By taking these precautions, we can collectively help to stem the tide of misinformation and ensure that the public has access to accurate and reliable information during this critical time.

**São Paulo Public Security Secretariat Denies Claims in Viral "Article," Cites Misinformation**

A recent viral “article” making the rounds online has been refuted by the Secretaria de Segurança Pública (Public Security Secretariat) of São Paulo. According to the secretariat, the claims presented in the article are unsubstantiated and lack factual basis.

In a statement released earlier today, the Secretaria de Segurança Pública asserted that they have found "no record with the characteristics cited in the article." This statement directly contradicts the claims made in the online piece, which has been circulating widely on social media platforms. The specific nature of the claims the secretariat is addressing remains unclear from the information provided, however, the strong denial suggests they are potentially sensitive or alarmist in nature.

Further undermining the credibility of the disputed "article," the Secretaria de Segurança Pública revealed that the image accompanying the text was not original. They traced the photograph back to a report aired on "Cidade Alerta," a news program broadcast on TV Record, on February 9, 2017. This revelation suggests the "article" is not based on recent or original reporting, but rather repurposes or misrepresents existing media content.

The use of old imagery raises serious concerns about the intent and accuracy of the circulating piece. By employing an unrelated image from a prior news report, the creators of the "article" appear to be manipulating visual context to potentially mislead readers or lend false authority to their claims.

This incident underscores the ongoing challenges associated with misinformation and the rapid spread of unverified information online. The Secretaria de Segurança Pública's swift response highlights the importance of official sources in debunking false narratives and maintaining public trust. Consumers of online content are encouraged to critically evaluate information and rely on credible news outlets and official statements for accurate reporting. The details of the original "article" remain unconfirmed, but the Secretariat's response serves as a strong reminder of the need for media literacy in the digital age.

आज जारी किए गए एक बयान में आयोग ने कहा कि वे "लेख में उल्लेख किए गए विशेषताओं वाले कोई रिकॉर्ड नहीं खोज पाए हैं।" यह बयान ऑनलाइन लेख में किए गए दावों के विरोध में है, जो सोशल मीडिया प्लेटफॉर्म पर व्यापक रूप से विस्तारित हो रहा है। हालांकि, आयोग द्वारा दिए गए दावों की विशिष्ट प्रकृति जानकारी के अभाव में स्पष्ट नहीं है, लेकिन मजबूत अस्वीकृति इस बात की संभावना बताती है कि वे संवेदनशील या चिंता उत्प्रेरक प्रकृति के हो सकते हैं।

इस घटना ने गलत जानकारी के फैलाव और ऑनलाइन अनुसंधान बिना जांच किए गए जानकारी के तेजी से फैलने के संबंध में बने रहे चुनौतियों को उजागर किया है। सार्वजनिक सुरक्षा राज्य आयोग के तेजी से प्रतिक्रिया गलत विचारों को खारिज करने और सार्वजनिक भरोसा बनाए रखने के महत्व को दर्शाती है। ऑनलाइन सामग्री के उपभोक्ताओं को जानकारी के बारे में विश्लेषण करने और सटीक रिपोर्ट के लिए विश्वसनीय खबर एजेंसियों और आधिकारिक घोषणाओं पर निर्भर करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया जाता है। वायरल "लेख" के मूल विवरण अभी तक पुष्टि नहीं किए गए हैं, लेकिन आयोग के प्रतिक्रिया के माध्यम से डिजिटल युग में मीडिया लेटरेसी की आवश्यकता के बारे में एक मजबूत याद दिलाई गई है।

The adoption of such a broad policy highlights the seriousness with which the Israeli government is approaching the ongoing pandemic. By impacting a large segment of the population, Israel aims to achieve greater control over infection rates and prevent outbreaks from spiraling out of control.

The term "partial isolation" distinguishes this strategy from a full lockdown, where citizens are typically confined to their homes except for essential activities. This implies that while movement and activity are restricted, people are still permitted to engage in certain aspects of normal life, albeit under specific guidelines. Further information is needed to understand the full scope of the policy and its impact on various sectors of Israeli society. ## Government Security Institute Denies Minister Received COVID-19 Treatment

The Government Security Institute (GSI) press office has issued a statement refuting claims that a minister within the government received treatment for COVID-19. Contacted by telephone, the GSI press office unequivocally stated that the minister in question did not undergo any form of treatment related to the disease.

The denial comes amidst speculation and potential misinformation circulating, although the specific origin or nature of those claims remains unclear. While the GSI statement is brief, it serves as a formal response to the rumors and aims to set the record straight.

It is important to note that the GSI's role is typically to protect the security and integrity of the government and its officials. In this context, the institute's involvement suggests that the circulating information, whether originating from social media, news outlets, or other sources, was deemed significant enough to warrant an official response.

The absence of further details regarding the source or content of the initial claims leaves unanswered questions. However, the GSI's straightforward denial underscores the government's intent to control the narrative surrounding the health and well-being of its leading figures. Moving forward, it remains to be seen whether the GSI will release further clarifications, or if the matter will be considered closed following this official statement. The public and media will likely continue to monitor for any further developments regarding this situation.
